plain.title: Recalled in the US
plain.why: The safety regulator in the US recalled this NEWDERY ZHX-PB22 because of a fire risk. It hasn't been recalled in India yet, so the version sold here may or may not be affected.
plain.todo: Check that the model number on the box or label is exactly ZHX-PB22. If it is, avoid buying it, or don't charge or use it unattended until the seller confirms it's safe.
plain.say: Recalled in the US, because of a fire risk. Not recalled in India yet. Check the model number before you buy.

steps.title: Compare the model number on your label with the recall
steps.detail: CPSC notice cpsc:example of 2024-06-13: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls lists the affected model numbers. Look on the label, base or box.

steps.title: Until you know, use it carefully
steps.detail: Don't charge it or leave it running unattended or overnight. Stop if it gets hot, smells, swells or sparks.

steps.title: Ask the shop whether yours is affected
steps.detail: Use the refund request below; it asks them to confirm.

steps.title: Report it
steps.detail: Send the regulator complaint below. It is filled in with the official records; add what happened to you.

steps.title: Save it to My Shelf
steps.detail: SafeShelf tells you if it is recalled later.

Thank you,

# SafeShelf case file INV-7Q2K9D1M

**Product:** NEWDERY ZHX-PB22 (NEWDERY 10000mAh Power Bank ZHX-PB22)
**Listing:** https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0EXAMPLE
**Checked:** 2026-10-16 · **Result (set by code, policy evidence-policy/1.0):** Recalled in the US
**Why:** The safety regulator in the US recalled this NEWDERY ZHX-PB22 because of a fire risk. It hasn't been recalled in India yet, so the version sold here may or may not be affected.

## Official records

- CPSC cpsc:example (2024-06-13, US): NEWDERY Power Banks Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls

## Where SafeShelf checked

- India: No recall found (India has no public recall list; we checked government safety orders)
- United States: Recall found for this model

_Guidance from official records and SafeShelf's code rules - not a regulatory determination or legal advice. No personal details are included; the shopper adds their own._
